hero.lead: I design, build and ship solutions at the speed your business needs. AI-powered development to deliver fast — security built in from the very first commit.

services.h2: Services built to deliver value, fast.
services.p: Full-stack, automation and security under one roof. Fewer vendors, less friction, more results.

svc1.p: End-to-end custom apps, from prototype to deployment. Maintainable code in JavaScript, Python and Django, ready to grow with you.

svc2.p: I connect your tools and remove repetitive manual work. Flows that sync data, notify and run processes on their own — hours saved every week.

svc3.p: Pentesting, hardening and best practices baked into the architecture, not patched on later. Your product is born protected and auditable.

svc4.p: AI-assisted development: shorter delivery times, same engineering rigor. We iterate at the speed the market demands.

about.h2: A network engineer who builds, automates and protects.
about.p1: I'm Jimmy Villacis, a Network & Connectivity Engineer (Cisco CCNA) with offensive-security training and full-stack development experience. I pair a solid infrastructure foundation with modern development to build solutions that work — and that are protected.
about.p2: After international experience in Australia, I now help businesses digitize and automate processes without sacrificing security. I leverage AI to shorten development cycles while keeping control, quality and best practices.

projects.p: A sample of my technical work. I'm expanding this space with new development and automation case studies.

prj1.p: Practical articles and notes on offensive security, networking and tooling. Lab documentation and learnings.

prj2.p: Case study in progress: tool integrations and automated flows to cut down manual work.

prj3.p: Real-time restaurant operating system: floor plan, orders, kitchen display, live billing and checkout. NestJS + Socket.io + PostgreSQL.

experience.p: A foundation combining networking, infrastructure support and enterprise customer service.

exp1.p: Corporate network design, VLAN implementation on UniFi UDM, technical documentation, project management with Gantt charts and information-security improvement proposals.

exp2.p: English studies (B2) and work in multicultural environments. Strengthened adaptability, autonomy and technical English in professional contexts.

exp3.p: Enterprise client request management, coordination with integrations and support teams, ticketing system handling.

exp4.p: Windows and Linux user support, equipment configuration (computers, POS, mobile), Active Directory and incident resolution.

exp5.p: Fiber-optic and structured-cabling installation and maintenance, fault diagnosis and CTO/NAP connections.

certs.p: Continuous learning across networking, security, cloud and development.
